clauses.mechanism: express revocation of EO 9196 performed by this order itself on May 31, 1947 (no effective-date wording; self-executing command spent on performance)
clauses.reason: The sole clause orders Executive Order 9196 of July 9, 1942 (Government Purchases of Prison-made Goods) revoked; the paragraph begins "Under and by virtue of the authority" and its last words are that the order "is hereby" revoked (the word is hyphenated across a line in the held text layer). The Federal Register text prints the signature date "May 31,1947." and a filing line whose date is June 2, 1947. The sentence has no effective-date wording, so the command to revoke was performed, and so exhausted, on signing, May 31, 1947. The first-end source is the held Federal Register text of the order itself. No later instrument, amendment, extension or earlier event alters or ends the command: the dossier chain is empty and the order states no until-date, report date or condition.

research_rationale:
EO 9859 was read in full in the registered Federal Register text layer (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_9859.txt, 12 FR 3557, PDF page 3); the census register row (date, title, President) agrees with the heading, title and date line printed in that text. The order's one operative sentence revokes Executive Order 9196 of July 9, 1942. Page location was checked against the PDF page markers of the held text layer only; no page image was inspected. The representation is a machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF, held as original_representation_unverified. The Federal Register text prints the signature date "May 31,1947." and a filing line with the filing date June 2, 1947. The sentence has no effective-date wording, so the revocation took effect on signing, May 31, 1947 (filed June 2, 1947). Under owner ruling 2026-10-28 (evidence decides) a command that was performed on its date is recorded as exhausted by performance on that date.

savings.reason: The order contains no savings, transfer or residual clause; it only revokes Executive Order 9196. The machine searches of the U.S. Code and the eCFR (both as of the October 14, 2026 cutoff, edition caveats stated in their coverage notes) and the Federal Register catalog return no hit citing EO 9859, so no held source continues any command of this order.
